Coder Fort

Learn to code, brick by brick!

Coder Fort is a free coding game for kids of 10 and up. You learn real Python and JavaScript one small step at a time, and every challenge you solve adds a brick to your fort.

  • Two towers to build: Python and JavaScript.
  • 66 challenges, from your first function to loops, lists and recursion.
  • Short lessons, hints one at a time, and errors explained in plain words.
  • No login, no ads. Your progress stays on your device.
